PROP-current-fina-asm-002.text: System assumes Move's linear type system prevents ObligationOwnerCap duplication or forgery.
PROP-current-fina-asm-002.assertion: assume: forall cap: is_unique(cap) AND cap.cannot_be_copied AND cap.cannot_be_forged

locations.note: Has key+store but NO copy ability — Move type system enforces uniqueness; forgery impossible without access to private fields
Only creation site; cap.obligation_id bound to obligation object ID at creation
